messages:
ana_docs: opened a compact PR combining a migration checklist for usage tiers + an SDK compatibility snippet for managed customers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4302 :seedling:
kevin_devex: can you paste the snippets and checklist here for a quick inline review? want to ensure were not exposing internal-only flags accidentally.
sam_eng: FYI infra changed metric naming last sprint from `redwood.rate.limit` -> `redwood.rate_limit`. recommend documenting an alias/recording-rule path so saved dashboards don't break.
nana_docs: pasted snippets inline. JS and TS examples plus a short PromQL alias suggestion:
```js
// JS (new stable API)
const tiers = await sdk.fetchUsageTiers({ projectId: 'proj_abc' });
// stable response shape:
// { id: 'tier.free', name: 'Free', allocation_tokens: 50000, burst_window_seconds: 60 }
console.log(tiers);

// Temporary compatibility (internal flag for managed customers only)
const legacy = await sdk.fetchUsageTiers({ projectId: 'proj_abc', compat_old_keys: true });
```
```ts
// TS (typed)
type Tier = { id: string; name: string; allocation_tokens: number; burst_window_seconds: number };
const tiers = await sdk.fetchUsageTiers({ projectId: 'proj_abc' }) as Tier[];
```
PromQL alias suggestion (docs snippet):
```promql
# Prefer recording rule to combine old & new metric names
# record: redwood_rate_limit_alias
# expr: redwood\.rate\.limit
avg_over_time(redwood_rate_limit_alias{project="proj_abc"}[30d])
```
nana_docs: Migration checklist (short):
- Audit saved dashboards and note panels referencing the old metric name.
- Add a recording rule or Grafana alias to surface historical data under `redwood_rate_limit_alias` during migration.
- Update SDK callers to `fetchUsageTiers()` and prefer stable keys.
- For managed customers only: request `compat_old_keys` for a 2-week transition window if immediate rollback is required.
- Publish changelog entry under "Docs" and link to the migration guide.
kevin_devex: nit: change "request `compat_old_keys`" -> "request a temporary compat flag (`compat_old_keys`)" to avoid implying it's self-serve. also, add a note to not store `compat_old_keys` in long-lived scripts.
sam_eng: confirm infra telemetry will emit both names for ~30 days? if so we should state that in docs. I'll confirm and leave a comment on the PR.
ci-bot: docs build for PR 4302 completed: success (lint: 0 warnings, 2 suggestions).
nana_docs: updated wording and added a short paragraph: "compat flags are temporary and available by request for managed/private customers—do not rely on them for production automation." changed the checklist language to "Review and update" for dashboards.
doc-bot: Added docs metadata tag `rate-limits` and `migration-guides`, updated TOC.
kevin_devex: looks good to me, please merge after infra confirms the dual-emission window and CI remains green. :thumbsup:
